title: A system role cannot be deleted
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Roles & Permissions list with at least one system role (for example Service Manager) visible.
custom_steps:
1. Find the Service Manager row.
  2. Look at the Actions column.
  3. If there is a three-dot menu, open it and look for Delete.
custom_expected: A system role cannot be deleted: either it shows only the eye icon (no three-dot menu), or the menu has no Delete, or Delete is disabled.
evidence: deletable=false for all system roles (live roles API).
